Prohibited Items

  • Aerosol cans (with the exception of sunscreen, sun block, hand sanitizer and bug spray)
  • Alcoholic beverages (not permitted to enter or exit the gates)
  • Any bag larger than 18x18x14 inches
  • Any firearm or illegal weapons
  • Collapsible chairs
  • Confederate Flags (includes all RV lots and parking areas)
  • Coolers
  • Dry Ice
  • Drones or any type of radio-controlled flying device
  • Fireworks
  • Folding chairsFrisbees, balloons, beach balls, footballs, or any other projectile sports-balls, etc.
  • Glass or ceramic containers
  • Golf carts, hoverboards, quads, UTVs, SxS, scooters, motorized e-scooters*, skateboards, Segways, dirt bikes or any other similar personal transportation devices (including licensed vehicles that may be street-legal)
  • Illegal drugs/substances of any kind
  • Knives longer than 3 inches in length when closed or longer than 6 inches in length when open
  • Laser pointers, noise-makers, air-horns
  • Monopods, tripods and selfie-sticks
  • Obscene or indecent clothing
  • Pets (except for service animals)
  • Seat cushions with armrests
  • Stadium seats wider than 18 inches or with arms
  • Umbrellas
  • Wagons that are not collapsible
